You asked us to move your store from BigCommerce to Shopify. This document gives two ways to do it, the changes we recommend to the current site, and what each option costs. The screenshots show your site today and the layouts we would use instead.

2

What we found and what we'd change

These changes are part of Option 1, so they are in both options.

AreaWhat we see todayWhat we'd do
HeaderSearch icon at the top, then a second search bar and a "Call Us" line under the menu (§2.1)Keep one search and the phone number in the header; remove the extra bar and line
ReviewsThree reviews stacked beside the "Reasons to Purchase" list (§2.2)Review slider, one at a time; or two separate sections
Home productsNo product section on the home page (§2.3)Add a featured products section with clean product cards
Bulk order formFull contact form on the home page (§2.4)Short text and a button to the Contact page
Page textLong text block at the bottom of the home page (§2.6)FAQ-style accordion
MobileHeavy header and long menu and footer lists (§2.7, §2.8)Compact header, accordion menu, toggle footer
CollectionsSort only; long product names are cut off (§2.9)Filters by price and category; Compare removed
Mini cartSmall dropdown with two buttons (§2.10)Cart drawer with quantity control, note and shipping estimate

2.1 Header and search

TodayThe red lines mark what we'd remove: the second search bar and the "Call Us At (720) 930-4667 Or Use Our Customer Order Form" line. Search and the phone number already sit in the header above.

ReferenceMock-up with your logo and photo. The header is one clean row, and the hero text and "Order Now!" button sit on the image.

2.2 Reasons to purchase and reviews

TodayThe list and three reviews share one row, so each review is squeezed. We'd show reviews in a slider, one at a time, in the order stars, name, text. The other way is two sections: "Why choose us" and "Reviews".

2.3 Featured products on the home page

ReferenceCard style we'd use: clear name, price, an "Engraving incl." or "Custom engraving" label and an "Add to cart" row.

ReferenceCard with category, SKU, rating and price range. We'd show ratings only if you keep product reviews on Shopify.

2.4 Bulk order form

TodayA full form sits on the home page. We'd replace it with a few lines of text and a button to the Contact page. If you want to keep the form here, we'd put a photo on one side and the form on the other.

2.5 Instagram

TodayThe strip of customer photos with your handle. We keep this section on the new home page (see question 3 in §4).

2.6 Page text as FAQ

TodayOne long block of text. We'd turn each heading into an FAQ question that opens and closes, so the page is shorter and the text stays on the page for search engines.

2.7 Mobile header and menu

TodayThe menu is one long list in capitals, and one entry reads "CATEGORY NAME: FOR HIM, CATEGORY PATH: FOR HIM". We'd clean the names, make each group open and close, and keep the header to logo, menu and cart.

2.8 Footer on mobile

TodayTwo long lists push the footer down the page.

ReferenceEach group opens with a "+" and the page stays short. We'd use this layout with your categories and policy links.

2.9 Collection page

TodayOnly a sort menu. The red box shows product names cut off after two lines. We'd add filters (price, category and similar) and let names show in full or end cleanly. We would not show Compare on these personalised products, because customers don't compare them like standard items.

2.10 Mini cart

TodayA small dropdown with "Check Out Now" and "View Cart".

ReferenceA cart drawer from another store. We'd take the quantity control, order note, shipping estimate and coupon. The free-shipping bar needs a threshold from you (see question 2 in §4).

2.11 Cart count on mobile

TodayOn desktop the cart shows the number of items.

TodayOn mobile the same cart icon shows no number. On Shopify the count shows on both.

3

Features

3.1 Product personalisation

For custom engraved products, customers could send what they want printed, as text or an image, on the product page. One app that does this is Customily Product Personalizer. We need to know which products need it before we can give hours. It is not in the hours in §6.

3.2 Wishlist and Compare

Ella already has both, so on Ella there is nothing to build. If you use another theme, or want an app or custom code, it is 15h. This is not in the hours in §6.

4

Open questions

#QuestionWhy it matters
1Which products need customer text or image upload?We can't give hours for §3.1 without it.
2Do you want a free-shipping bar in the cart? At what order value?The bar needs a threshold. We won't use the $500 from the reference.
3Should the Instagram section show your live feed, or a fixed set of photos?A live feed may need an app.
4Where should the "Customer Order Form" link go once the line under the menu is removed?We'd move it to the menu or the Contact page so customers can still find it.
5Option 2 only: do you have brand guidelines (colours, fonts) for the new design?We design the Homepage, Collection and Product pages from them and avoid rework.

We use Ella by HaloThemes. It is free to you through our partnership. It already includes the slider, FAQ accordion, filters, cart drawer, wishlist and Compare used in this proposal.

7

Who configures what

Payment and shipping are set up by you in your Shopify admin. We guide you and verify the result, but we don't enter the credentials. They give access to your money and your carrier rates, so they stay with the account holder.

ItemYou doWe do
Payment providerOpen the account, enter the credentials, run the first live orderGive you a step-by-step guide, test checkout
Shipping zones & ratesEnter zones and rates, keep them up to dateWalk you through it, test real addresses
